name: Ready Deals lifecycle filter opens the ready-deal workspace
description:
Objective: Ready Deals lifecycle filter opens the ready-deal workspace.
Preconditions: Open Deals with the configured test data.
Steps:
1. Open Deals.
2. Ready Deals lifecycle filter opens the ready-deal workspace.
3. Observe the resulting state.
Expected: The expected records, controls, or page state are displayed.
